title: Understanding PCA
text: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to emphasize variation and bring out strong patterns in a dataset. It projects data onto principal component axes.

title: Interpreting the Scatter Plot
text: The scatter plot shows a linear relationship between two variables. Consider how PCA might affect this relationship.

title: Analyzing the Projections
text: When data is projected onto the first principal component (pc1), it captures the most variance. The second principal component (pc2) captures the remaining variance orthogonal to pc1.
